question: At a fixed architecture, step and ray budget, how does training-view depth supervision affect held-out radiance-field geometry and color on M2 Max?
prior_exposure: All held-out views existed in the previous surfel delivery; none has trained either reconstruction. Development/final separation here is prospective for neural experiments, not a claim that the dataset was never viewed.
primary_metrics: absolute camera-z depth error on all reference depths in (0.4,3.5) m, without predicted-depth gating
fraction of valid reference pixels with depth error below 0.05 m
analysis: Report each view, median, mean, paired full-vs-ablation differences and seed sensitivity. No population significance claim; neighboring views are correlated.
controls: Identical random initialization for seed 42, RGB rays, scene bounds, optimizer schedule, step budget and sample count. Depth targets affect only full-run losses; shared bounds come from training depth, so the ablation is not a depth-free pipeline.
references: existing depth-initialized surfels with fixed 5x5 footprint (not matched-compute)

acceptance.training: At least 3000 optimization steps per run, finite nonzero gradients and parameter changes in features/density/color; measured MPS execution; no pretrained reconstruction model.
acceptance.analysis: Inspect at least three final views including worst PSNR and worst depth; retain failures and all runs. Report RGB/geometry tradeoffs and seed variability.
acceptance.recovery: Resume saved model, Adam state and CPU RNG under identical config; compare bounded MPS uninterrupted/resumed paths and disclose nondeterminism.
acceptance.integration: Actual browser displays learned 3D surface and held-out neural renders; original semantic positive, absent, ambiguous, orbit, source and reset flows still pass.

selection: Choose architecture/budget using pilot and development views only; freeze full configs before final evaluation. Select the delivered full checkpoint using mean development PSNR subject to mean development depth MAE <=0.12m. No final-view model selection.
revision_bound: At most two documented development revisions if pilot or development quality fails; never lower final acceptance thresholds after observing final results.
